entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-04
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • SQLite: DateTime.Ticks translation loses sub-millisecond precision and is off by floating-point error #39531
  • Translate Array.Exists to Queryable.Any #39527
  • Updating a single JSON property ignores its JsonValueReaderWriter #39526
  • Filter on JSON complex property over a LEFT JOIN drops unmatched rows #39523

Closed

  • Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.SqlServer v10.0.14 transitively resolves vulnerable System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs (v9.0.11) #39519
  • Query precompiler rejects class constant as unknown identifier in predicate #39273
    12.0-preview1
  • Compiled model writes `NullableValueComparer<TComparer>` (CS0453) for a struct's ValueComparer applied to a nullable property #39291
    12.0-preview1
  • Support ReadOnlyMemory as embedding type in Cosmos vector model #34320
    9.0.0
  • Add PrecompileQueries and NativeAot switches to Optimize-DbContext #34550
    12.0-preview1
  • Tests in SqliteCommandTest are flaky #35585
    12.0-preview1
  • [JsonPropertyName] is ignored for complex properties and complex collections mapped to JSON #39484
    12.0-preview1
  • 'Argument types do not match' when selecting off of a projection with a null check #34411
    12.0-preview1
  • SqlServer: Translate TimeSpan members #19632
    12.0-preview1
